body:
## Summary
- require retained controller runtime artifact paths before an all-true observation record can close the gate
- keep missing-artifact all-true records insufficient instead of pass
- document the artifact_paths pass requirement in the controller runtime runbook

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_controller_runtime -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness -v
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release tools.tests.test_controller_runtime -v
- make evidence-tools-test
- make phase0-stable-release-gate

This is evidence-tool hardening only. It does not close controller runtime acceptance or Phase 0 stable release.
title: Harden controller runtime artifact evidence gate
